verdict.rationale: Bench is a bookkeeping service plus software, so a month-end close checklist is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence pack shows no checklist that tracks reconciliations, accruals, or review sign-offs. The closest items are adjacent: automatic merchant-fee reconciliation, generic task reminders, and a tax filing-status overview, none of which is a close checklist.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can run a month-end close against a checklist that tracks reconciliations, accruals, and review sign-offs
